name: AI Institute Summer Camp
operator_name: Paul English Applied AI Institute, UMass Boston
description_short: A five week, project based AI program run by UMass Boston faculty, with in person days on Mondays and Fridays on campus and virtual sessions Tuesday to Thursday. Each week covers one topic, from machine learning to robotics and generative AI, and ends in portfolio projects; no coding experience is needed.

sessions.name: Week 1: Introduction to AI and Machine Learning
Week 2: Neural Networks to Intelligent Machines
Week 3: Speech and Natural Language Processing
Week 5: Build Your First AI Project and Research Portfolio

notes: Weeks can be taken singly or stacked in any order ($899 a week, $4,495 for all five). Lunch is provided on the in person days. A one day AI in One Day event on August 28 costs $399. Up to 20 spots a week.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. The page gives July 27 to August 28 as five weeks; the week dates are the Monday to Friday weeks in that span. Phone and address are the UMass Boston main ones in the page footer

source.title: AI Institute Summer Camp ‘26 - UMass Boston

for_andrew: The page never states ages or grades. Its FAQ talks about 9th graders and the discovery note said high school students, so I left ages out.
Three of the five days each week are virtual (in person only Monday and Friday). Is a hybrid program something we list as a camp?
